We're heading into the weekend with ongoing 25% off deals on AirPods Pro 3 and $100 off AirPods Max 2. But today's 9to5Toys Lunch Break headline is the most affordable 13-inch M5 MacBook Air landing at $1,099 in 3 colors via Apple's official refurbished store ($200 off) while supplies last — this configuration tends to sell out fast. We also have MacBook Neo deals up to $120 off, Apple Watch Ultra 3 with Natural or Black Milanese Loop down nearly $100 at Amazon, and the latest 240W woven Beats USB-C cable dropping to $18 Prime shipped for an Amazon low (40% off). Be sure to check out our updated 2026 Best Buy Back to School deals roundup below for more.

AirPods summer deals continue: $100 off Max 2, AirPods Pro 3 25% off from $99

  • AirPods Pro 3 $190 (orig. $249)
  • AirPods Max 2 $449 (orig. $549)
  • AirPods 4 $99 (orig. $129)
  • AirPods 4 ANC $149 (orig. $179)
  • AirPods 4 ANC $119 (orig. $179 new) — Renewed Premium

Best Buy refreshes 2026 Back to School deals: TVs under $500, $130 off Bose, Apple gear, Ninja kitchen and more

Most affordable 13-inch M5 MacBook Air returns to $1,099 in 3 colors via Apple official refurbished store ($200 off)

Apple's official refurbished storefront is always a great place to save some cash given the price increases on the current MacBook lineup at retail. But the base configurations of the Pro and M5 MacBook Air lineup are moving fast, and this morning we spotted the most affordable 13-inch M5 MacBook Air in three colors available for $1,099 — $200 off the original price.

Apple's official certified refurbished storefront is now offering the 13-inch M5 MacBook Air with 16GB of RAM and 512GB of storage for $1,099 with free shipping. As of writing this deal is still live in Midnight, Starlight, and Sky Blue models.

These machines come with the following coverage:

  • Apple 1-year limited warranty
  • Apple 14-day return policy
  • Eligible for AppleCare
  • Apple strict refurbishment process before resale

This is the most affordable configuration of the M5 MacBook Air which retails for $1,299 brand new. Today's Apple refurbished deal is $200 below the new retail price and is the best we can find on the base model in the current generation lineup.

  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/512GB $1,099 (orig. $1,299 new)
  • Midnight, Starlight, and Sky Blue

This is Apple's refurbished store so it's arguably one of the better quality refurbished MacBook Airs out there, but how does it compete with current retail pricing on new units?

Amazon is currently at MSRP for this configuration with only the Silver model coming in slightly lower at $1,240. Although there was a time when this machine was going for less than this, since the price increase we haven't seen new units at Amazon dip below $1,149, and even then it was a very brief deal about a month ago.

Apple Watch Ultra 3 with Natural or Black Milanese Loop down nearly $100 at Amazon

If I had to choose, the two best looking smartwatch combos on the planet are down nearly $100 at Amazon right now — the Natural Titanium or Black Apple Watch Ultra 3 paired with the Milanese Loop.

Although the $100 off deal on the more affordable Ocean Band configurations is gone, Amazon is now offering the Natural or Black Titanium Apple Watch Ultra 3 with Milanese Loop for $799.99 with free shipping.

These two configurations retail for $899 thanks to the gorgeous woven steel Milanese Loop band, but they're now down close to $100 at Amazon:

  • Black Apple Watch Ultra 3 with Milanese Loop $800 (orig. $899)
  • Natural Titanium Apple Watch Ultra 3 with Milanese Loop $800 (orig. $899)

Apple is expected to debut the next generation Ultra wearable next month, but with RAMageddon already spreading across the iPad and MacBook lineups, there's a chance the new Apple Watch models could be the next victim. The current lineup hasn't been affected yet, but they are miniature wrist computers after all, and the Ultra 4/Series 12 might be next.

We certainly wouldn't blame anyone for waiting to see what else Apple has in store for September, but these things could get stupid expensive in less than a month.

The Series models could be facing the same fate, and they're currently $100 off at Amazon too:

  • 42mm Apple Watch Series 11 $299 (orig. $399)
  • 46mm Apple Watch Series 11 $329 (orig. $429)

Grab the latest 240W woven Beats USB-C cable down at $18 Prime shipped for an Amazon low (40% off)

Pick up a few of these 10-foot Beats woven USB-C cables while the 240W black model is still at $18 Prime shipped for an all-time low.

Amazon has the latest 10-foot Beats 240W USB-C woven cable down at $18.03 with free shipping for Prime members or orders over $35.

These new-for-2026 models carry higher power transfer capabilities and retail for $30, which is honestly quite expensive even for a premium 10-foot USB-C cable. But at 40% off, I think everyone should have a few of these higher-end, nicer-looking models in their everyday carry or home collection.

Today's lowest price is on the Bolt Black model, but we also spotted Navy at $19, Surge Stone down at $20.85 with the on-page coupon, and the red model is right around $24.

As mentioned above, this is the latest model which jumped from 60W on the previous generation to a solid 240W of power, plus the longer 10-foot cable, and the same tangle-resistant woven design, "for more durability and convenience. Upgrade your charging experience and say goodbye to knots, bends, and wear."

Amazon restocks 46mm Apple Watch Series 11 cellular models with $100 discounts from $299

Anker's latest 3-in-1 Qi2 25W foldable MagSafe charging stand returns to Prime Day low (35% off)

I reviewed this product earlier this year when it launched and Anker's 25W 3-in-1 Prime foldable MagSafe charger has become a staple in my everyday carry, travel bag, and home charging setup. Now at nearly 35% off, we have another shot at it at the tracked low price over at Amazon.

Anker's official Amazon storefront is now offering the latest 25W 3-in-1 Prime foldable MagSafe charger for $99.97 with free shipping.

This charger, which normally retails for $150, features a 3-in-1 design with MagSafe pad delivering up to 25W of power, with both the Phantom Gray/Black and Radiant White colorways at nearly 35% off.

The deals this week match what we previously featured, stacking with Anker's summer sale discount and this year's Prime Day pricing.

Although it's palm-sized and travel-friendly, it has some weight to it and can sit nicely on your desk or nightstand whether you're working from home or on the go.

  • Launch deal: Brand new Schlage Home Key Sense Pro smart lock with Ultra Wideband auto unlock
  • KeySmart clear 'Ghost' SmartCard Find My wallet tracker returns to Amazon low
  • Spigen mini MagSafe iPhone backpack/EDC pouch down to $27
  • Anker 5-port Nano travel adapter covers '200+ countries' from $20

Apple official refurbished store MacBook Neo lowest prices up to $120 off original pricing

Aside from the MacBook Air and the M5 MacBook Pro lineup, Apple's even more affordable new MacBook Neo has also seen price increases recently, but you can side-step those hikes via Apple's official certified refurbished storefront — MacBook Neo starts at $689 over at Amazon, but you can grab one from the best quality Apple refurbished store with full Apple warranty from $599.

Apple's official certified refurbished storefront has all MacBook Neo configurations at the lowest prices we can find, undercutting any somewhat reputable source by a wide margin while still coming with official Apple warranty and Apple's 'strict' refurbished quality stamp of approval.

  • Apple refurbished MacBook Neo 256GB $599 (orig. $699 new)
  • Apple refurbished MacBook Neo 512GB with Touch ID $679 (orig. $799 new)

Although you won't see special deals noted on the product pages over at Apple's refurbished storefront, all models are at least $100 below new MSRP — with the 512GB model with Touch ID keyboard actually $120 below the new original pricing, which is $20 below even its previous original price.

Yes, they're refurbished and they're just bringing the pricing back to or close to the previous MSRP levels, but we're talking about the lowest prices on the most affordable MacBooks in the current generation lineup.

For some people, saving $100 to $120 isn't worth buying refurbished, which is totally understandable, but it's certainly nothing to sneeze at and we're talking about the highest quality refurbished products directly from Apple.
